kotaFacultyTricks.title: First 20 Seconds
kotaFacultyTricks.content: Identify whether the question is primarily testing quadratic expressions and equations or nature of roots before writing equations.

kotaFacultyTricks.title: Exam Strategy
kotaFacultyTricks.content: Write the governing relation first, preserve the symbolic form, and apply restrictions before substitution.
